statement: For the fixed point w=h^omega(0) defined in source.md, for every s in N_0 and all positive m,n with m+n <= 2745, n Psi(w_s...w_{s+m-1}) is not equal to m Psi(w_{s+m}...w_{s+m+n-1}). Consequently, if the frozen claim (C) is false, every counterexample has total length m+n >= 2746.
contribution: A globally quantified certified lower bound rather than a prefix-only observation: cyclic equivariance and four complete nonzero-difference representatives in h(0) embed every factor of w of length at most 2745, up to alphabet permutation, into h^4(0), while an exact exhaustive sweep of h^4(0) finds no violating split.
